name: Sex and Law in Modern America

assessments.name: Oral Exam
assessments.description: Students will be examined on the policy memo and be asked to explain their approach to the topic and defend their policy recommendation.

assessments.name: Research Policy Memo
assessments.description: Students will write a policy memo that examines the context of a pressing issue of the student’s choice regarding sex and law in modern America. The memo will make a policy recommendation for state or local-level action in response to a particular problem
assessments.dueRaw: Formal exam period Due date : 15 Jun 2026 at 23:59

assessments.name: Tutorial Question
assessments.description: Students will write 2-3 questions for tutorial meant to demonstrate understanding of lecture and assigned readings

assessments.name: Short essay
assessments.description: Students will write a short essay in response to prompts provided by the instructor. The essay will demonstrate critical thinking skills as applied to lectures and assigned readings for the unit.

assessments.name: Research Proposal
assessments.description: Students will write a brief research proposal that identifies a key question for research, 5-10 sources for consideration, and a hypothesis.

assessments.name: Participation-- contribution
assessments.description: Students will engage in active, informed participation in tutorial and lecture.
